originals.name: Sticky threat
originals.idea: Threat goes to the attacker with the largest share of damage received, with stickiness and a healing term.
originals.change: stickiness band (value to tune) and healing term; engine-owned list; donor's GetHate ignores healing

originals.name: Counter stance
originals.idea: One-shot retaliation per window that re-arms on a cooldown.

originals.name: Spent-then-flee
